limits.en: framer.site domain, 1,000 pages, 10 CMS collections, 1 GB bandwidth, 5 MB file uploads, 500 AI credits, no custom domain.

keyLimits.en: Custom domain included, 30 site pages, 2 CMS collections, 50 GB bandwidth, built-in SEO.
150 site pages (expandable to 700 with add-ons), 10 CMS collections, 100 GB bandwidth, staging environment, branching with previews.
Custom limits, unlimited editors, enterprise-grade security, uptime guarantee, SCIM, SSO.

addOns.en: Extra editor seat: $20/month; content editor seat: $10/month; viewer seats are free.

cautions.en: Displayed plan prices are billed yearly; monthly-billing prices were not separately confirmed on the page in this session.
AI credits are limited (500 on free plan) and consumed by AI-assisted features, a mechanism worth checking before relying on them heavily.

capabilities.en: No-code/low-code visual website builder with a built-in CMS for content-driven pages.
Staging environment and branching with previews on the Pro plan for safer publishing workflows.
AI credits for AI-assisted design/content features included on all plans.

limitations.en: Free plan has no custom domain and caps CMS collections and bandwidth.
Page count is capped even on Pro (150, extendable to 700 max via add-ons), which can limit large content sites.

reason.en: Direct competitor no-code website builder with a similar visual design + CMS approach.
Mainstream website builder targeting a similar non-developer audience.
Another all-in-one website builder competing for the same small-business/portfolio use case.

unknowns: Monthly (non-annual) billing prices for Basic and Pro were not separately displayed/confirmed on the page fetched in this session.
